title: Tundra: 4 of 7 species are generic code-drawn recolors, not matching their names
steps: In the console: for each of __isles.packSpecies call __isles.spawn(sp, tx, ty) a few tiles below the hero, then read __isles.creatures() src field
expected: Each species reads as its name (icicle bat = a bat, glacier shellback = a shelled creature, shagtusk/sabrefang = tusked / fanged beasts) at the same quality as the PNG species (pengling, frostfox, rimewolf)
actual: glacier_shellback, icicle_bat, shagtusk, sabrefang all report src:'code'; on screen they are a horned blob and a blue quadruped template with a saddle-like stripe, plus a dark wolf-face. icicle_bat is not a bat. Clear quality gap next to the PNG penguin/wolf/fox
suspect: game/games/isles/isles.js (MMCreatureStrips only has pengling/frostfox/rimewolf for tundra); game/shared/mm-creature-draw.js code bake

title: Mars: every species is code-drawn from two shared body templates
steps: Spawn all __isles.packSpecies (regolith_roly, bubblemoth, rustbeetle, dust_devil, crater_strider) below the hero
expected: Five distinct readable creatures (moth, beetle, dust devil...)
actual: All 5 are src:'code'. Roly, bubblemoth and dust_devil render as the same horned blob; rustbeetle and crater_strider as the same saddled quadruped, only recolored. Names and sprites do not match (no moth wings, no beetle shell, no dust swirl)
suspect: game/games/isles/isles.js STRIPS preload (no mars strips); game/shared/mm-creature-draw.js

title: Frost Dragon and Red Titan use the same yeti-like humanoid sprite, recolored
expected: A frost dragon looks like a dragon; the red titan is a distinct colossus. Tyrant and Hydra have bespoke PNG art
actual: Both bosses are the same bipedal blob-bear body (blue vs orange), no wings or dragon traits. Arena ring is the code ring (arenaSrc ''), boss src is ''. Weakest visual in the game at the climax of two islands
suspect: game/games/isles/isles.js boss draw path (strips only for fernjaw_tyrant and tide_hydra)

title: Weary boss is killed by about 4 s of continued fire; the tame chance is lost easily
steps: ?test=1&isle=jungle, give 3 feast, bossSpawn, bossHit(2400,false) so the Fernjaw Tyrant goes weary (hp ~260)
Keep hitting (bossHit(300)) as an auto-firing player holding ATTACK would, before pressing F
expected: A short grace or hold-fire protection at weary so a player who keeps tapping Attack can still choose Feed (the toast says 'feast to tame, or finish it')
actual: boss st goes weary -> dead; bossFeed returns {ok:false, why:'none'}. At 14 dmg per 0.25 s bolt, 260 HP is about 4.5 s of held fire; hold-to-fire is the default on phones, and F also needs the hero inside the feed radius. The only tame path is easy to blow by accident. (Bot-driven via the test hook, not a human-timed run: frequency of loss in real play unmeasured)
suspect: game/shared/mm-isle-boss.js:223 (weary damage kills normally); game/games/isles/isles.js:1203 weary toast

title: Home, jungle and tundra feel empty: 0 creatures at start, 1 in view after a minute of walking
steps: Walk the hero in a loop for ~60 s of sim time (step()), logging __isles.creatures().length every 2.5 s
expected: A handful of wild creatures near the hero to fight or tame on each island
actual: Counts: meadow 0 then 1 (one puffwool about 10 tiles away), jungle 0 then 1 (one chompbill), tundra 1-2 (pengling). Reef gave 9-12 and mars 3. First sight on the three open islands is empty terrain with no creature on screen, so the 'tame' pitch in the how-to card has nothing to act on. (My loop returned to its start tile, so it measured spawn cadence, not roaming density)

title: Start areas read as flat uniform fields (jungle beach, reef sand, mars regolith)
steps: Open each isle at 390x844 with no test flag, look at the spawn screen
expected: Visual variety (props, tile variation) on the first screen
actual: Jungle start is two large flat sand/fern blocks with one glint; reef start is one sand tone with a stair-step path; mars is one orange field with a few pebbles. Biome identity only appears further in (e.g. jungle ruin floor in the boss arena looks good)
suspect: game/shared/mm-overworld.js prop density on beach bands

title: Phone HUD truncates the island name: 'Frostfang Tund...' and 'Wanderer - ...'
expected: The island name is readable in the HUD
actual: The PACK button consumes the card width, so the title line shows 'Wanderer - ...' and the island line 'Hearth Isle - ...' / 'Frostfang Tund...' / 'Verdant Jungle...' on every island. The h1 text exists; only the visible HUD is clipped

title: Lift-off scene: rocket is drawn at the bottom edge under the hint toast and buttons
steps: ?test=1&isle=meadow&at=dock, give rocket_core_drift inputs and craft it, tap Sail, tap 'Sail to Red Waste'
expected: The rocket is the hero of the scene, visible and centred
actual: The rocket starts below the dock, in the sea, and its lower half sits behind the 'The dock. Tap Sail...' toast and the Decor/Sail buttons; the launch is hard to read at phone size. Travel itself works and lands on the mars landing pad

title: How-to card covers the centre of the screen (and bosses); journal/medal toasts print on top of it
steps: Open any isle for the first time at 390x844 and wait 3-8 s
Walk into a new creature's range (toast 'New in your journal: X')
expected: Overlays do not stack; a boss or creature met in the first seconds is not hidden
actual: The 5-line How to play card covers roughly screen rows 30-75 percent. The 'Medal' / 'New in your journal' toast renders on top of it so both texts overlap (img 03/04), and in boss shots the card hides the boss body. Already listed as open in bugbash/isles.md, confirmed with boss evidence
suspect: game/games/isles/isles.js how-to card timing (9 s or 2.5 s after first input)
